title: Italfarmaco and VeriSIM Life Partner to Develop Novel HDAC-Targeting Therapeutics for Neuromuscular, Fibrotic, and Rare Diseases
source_used: AllSci, its own report of the announcement (the Business Wire release is blocked)
key_facts: Italy-based Italfarmaco S.p.A. and San Francisco-based VeriSIM Life, Inc. have entered a discovery collaboration to develop novel small-molecule inhibitors against an undisclosed histone deacetylase (HDAC) target for neuromuscular, fibrotic and rare diseases.

Total potential value exceeds USD 100 million; VeriSIM is eligible for technology service fees, development, regulatory and commercial milestones, and royalties on future products; specific upfront economics were not disclosed.

VeriSIM will apply its AtlasGEN platform to generate and optimize synthesizable chemical matter and its BIOiSIM platform to evaluate pharmacology, exposure, safety, biomarkers and translational potential.
Italfarmaco contributes its expertise in HDAC biology, medicinal chemistry, translational science and clinical development.

The partnership builds on Italfarmaco's HDAC franchise, led by givinostat (Duvyzat), which received US FDA approval for Duchenne muscular dystrophy in 2024; Italfarmaco is also developing selective HDAC6- and class I-directed candidates.
The collaboration remains at the discovery stage, with no development candidate, target isoform or clinical program disclosed.
